nodes.notes: Create a Header Auth credential: name = Authorization, value = Bearer <your Apify API token> (console.apify.com/settings/integrations). Runs bill to your own Apify account at the Store price.

parameters.content:
## Email Verifier (domain, MX, disposable)
Check a list of email addresses for syntax, domain, MX records and disposable domains. It does not check the mailbox and does not send mail (no SMTP check).

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/email-verifier
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/email-verifier

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
